name: Kamipani!
source:
Tomoyuki has moved to his hometown in the country and started living alone. He meets his childhood friends, Megumi, Nonoka, and Amane, and enjoys his life there.

But one day, a girl suddenly comes to his house. She calls herself god, and begins to live at his house. He doesn't know what's going on...?

Something new now starts at his good old hometown...

[From ErogeShop]
